$comment: Synchronized machine-readable twin of FEATURES.md. A feature status change must update both files in the same pull request. Status vocabulary: implemented | partial | planned | deprecated.

json-spec.notes: FormSpec / FormFieldSpec / FormElement — the JSON source of truth.

field-types-20.notes: All 20 field types with rendering + validation.

structural-types.notes: heading, description, divider, section — render-only, never validated or sent.

wizard-steps.notes: step markers, shared prefix, hoisted hidden fields, step-scoped validation.

stepper-chrome.notes: stepper.nav + stepper.header, per-marker overrides, clickable completed steps.

canonical-data.notes: Trimmed values, comma-joined multi-values, filenames for files.

rules-pattern.notes: Custom regex on string fields, soft-validated by the shared script; fails open on a broken pattern.

rules-length.notes: minLength/maxLength soft bounds; maxLength draws a live N / max character counter.

rules-cross-match.notes: sameAs cross-field equality; partner re-checks live when the target changes.

rules-selection-bounds.notes: minSelect/maxSelect on groups and multi-selects; minSelect > 0 implies required.

rules-file-bounds.notes: maxSize (bytes or 5MB-style units) + allowedTypes MIME globs per file, minFiles/maxFiles counts on multiple inputs — all read ctx.files; minFiles > 0 implies required.

button-specs.notes: Label or { label, variant } for submit/next/prev.

grid-sizing.notes: 12-column spans from size percentage via gridSpan.

repeaters.notes: Repeater row groups — add/remove rows with minRows/maxRows bounds, row-scoped validation, structured JSON-array payload per group.

binding-astro.notes: .astro shells over the runtime builders + initForms.

binding-vanilla.notes: renderForm / attachForm / initForms with detach lifecycle.

mailer-cf7.notes: CF7 REST feedback endpoint + payload policy (default mailer).

mailer-json.notes: Generic POST of the canonical payload; serverless-worker path.

mailer-nodemailer.notes: First-party Nodemailer delivery adapter (documented follow-up release).

validation-vanilla.notes: Regex rules keyed by field type.

validation-zod.notes: Structural zod v3/v4 adapter — optional peer.

ux-status-mode.notes: inline default; replace collapses the form to the success box.

ux-file-uploads.notes: Single + multiple; filenames in canonical payload; cf7 re-attaches bytes.

ux-multi-select.notes: select multiple: true with rows height.

ux-datalist.notes: options on non-picker inputs -> datalist suggestions.

ux-a11y.notes: aria-invalid, role=status, aria-busy/current, inert panes, focus management.

quality-test-suite.notes: Core/mailers, markup snapshots, TanStack + Zod suites, engine under happy-dom.

quality-examples.notes: astro-demo, react-demo (route parity), tanstack-demo, shared specs.

release-tags.notes: v0.1.0, v0.2.0, v0.3.0 immutable git tags.

release-npm-publish.notes: Drop private: true and release a versioned build.
